title: Grid modeling starter inventory
scope: Practical first choices across the US, Europe and global sources. This is a starting shortlist, not an exhaustive ranking or a validated study-input package.

datasets.name: PyPSA-Eur grid dataset
datasets.use: Start an open European transmission model with assembled network inputs.
datasets.caveat: An OSM-derived representation; validate electrical parameters and release-specific inputs.

datasets.name: PyPSA-Earth grid dataset
datasets.use: Build open regional networks where utility models are unavailable.
datasets.caveat: Coverage and inferred parameters vary; this is not an operator's validated network.

datasets.name: PGLib-OPF
datasets.use: Benchmark AC optimal power flow across standardized cases.
datasets.caveat: Benchmark cases do not establish current real-world grid conditions.

datasets.name: MATPOWER case archive
datasets.use: Start power-flow and OPF experiments in a widely supported case format.
datasets.caveat: Check each case's origin and terms; the software BSD license does not cover all case data.

datasets.name: Texas A&M synthetic grids
datasets.use: Study realistic-scale networks with openly shared synthetic cases.
datasets.caveat: Geographic realism does not make these actual utility networks.

datasets.name: SimBench
datasets.use: Test distribution-grid methods with network cases and time series.
datasets.caveat: Representative benchmark networks; adapt assumptions to the local utility.

datasets.name: EIA-860
datasets.use: Build a US generator inventory with capacity, technology and status.
datasets.caveat: Annual and preliminary releases differ; join using plant and generator identifiers.

datasets.name: EIA-923
datasets.use: Calibrate generation, fuel use and delivered fuel costs.
datasets.caveat: Reporting aggregation and reporting frequency vary; it is not hourly unit dispatch.

datasets.name: GEM Global Integrated Power Tracker
datasets.use: Assemble a global power-asset inventory across technologies.
datasets.caveat: Coverage thresholds and update cycles differ by underlying tracker.

datasets.name: WRI Global Power Plant Database
datasets.use: Use a reproducible historical global plant baseline.
datasets.caveat: Legacy release: check vintage and supplement recent additions and retirements.

datasets.name: EPA eGRID
datasets.use: Attach plant-level generation and emissions context to fleet studies.
datasets.caveat: Annual emissions accounting data do not directly provide marginal emissions.

datasets.name: PUDL
datasets.use: Use cleaned, linked EIA and FERC tables for fleet and utility cost analysis.
datasets.caveat: Record the release and table: normalized outputs inherit source reporting limitations.

datasets.name: LBNL Queued Up
datasets.use: Compare generation and storage interconnection pipelines across operators.
datasets.caveat: Queue capacity is proposed capacity; withdrawals and coverage matter.

datasets.name: CAISO interconnection queue
datasets.use: Inspect CAISO project status and queue details at the source.
datasets.caveat: Statuses change; a queue position is not a completion forecast.

datasets.name: PJM service requests
datasets.use: Inspect PJM serial and cycle interconnection requests.
datasets.caveat: Account for queue-process changes and distinguish active, withdrawn and completed projects.

datasets.name: MISO generator interconnection queue
datasets.use: Inspect MISO project pipeline and interconnection study information.
datasets.caveat: Some study-cycle information appears separately; avoid assuming one export is complete.

datasets.name: ERCOT generator interconnection status
datasets.use: Track planned generation using ERCOT's monthly GIS reports.
datasets.caveat: Monthly status reports are snapshots of proposals, not committed additions.

datasets.name: ENTSO-E TYNDP projects
datasets.use: Review cross-border transmission and storage development projects.
datasets.caveat: This is a transmission planning pipeline, not a generator interconnection queue.

datasets.name: EIA-930 Hourly Electric Grid Monitor
datasets.use: Build hourly balancing-authority demand and interchange series.
datasets.caveat: Check time conventions, missing values and balancing-authority boundary changes.

datasets.name: ENTSO-E actual total load
datasets.use: Obtain actual and forecast load across European bidding zones.
datasets.caveat: Resolve local time, daylight saving and zone definitions; API access has registration requirements.

datasets.name: Open Power System Data time series
datasets.use: Start with harmonized load, wind and solar time series.
datasets.caveat: The listed time-series package is a historical release (2020-10-06), not a live feed.

datasets.name: NESO Historic Demand Data
datasets.use: Analyze GB demand alongside embedded generation and interconnector flows.
datasets.caveat: Understand the published demand definition and revisions before comparing with other load series.

datasets.name: ResStock / ComStock End-Use Load Profiles
datasets.use: Model building end-use demand shapes and electrification scenarios.
datasets.caveat: Simulated representative building profiles are not individual customer meter readings.

datasets.name: FERC Form 714
datasets.use: Assemble hourly demand reported by planning areas and balancing authorities.
datasets.caveat: Reporting formats and respondent boundaries change; reconcile identifiers before joining years.

datasets.name: ERA5
datasets.use: Create consistent multiyear weather inputs for wind, solar and demand modeling.
datasets.caveat: Reanalysis is modeled weather; convert heights, accumulations and units explicitly.

datasets.name: National Solar Radiation Database (NSRDB)
datasets.use: Build solar resource and PV production profiles.
datasets.caveat: Coverage, resolution and years depend on the product; API access may require a key.

datasets.name: WIND Toolkit
datasets.use: Build wind generation profiles from gridded meteorology at multiple heights.
datasets.caveat: Specify the product and weather years; modeled wind speed needs a turbine conversion.

datasets.name: NASA POWER
datasets.use: Quickly obtain solar and meteorological inputs through an accessible API.
datasets.caveat: Coarse gridded inputs suit screening; assess suitability for local extremes and terrain.

datasets.name: Renewables.ninja
datasets.use: Generate or obtain modeled wind and PV output profiles.
datasets.caveat: Respect request limits and dataset-specific terms; default data terms restrict commercial use.

datasets.name: Global Wind Atlas
datasets.use: Screen wind-resource quality and candidate areas with spatial resource layers.
datasets.caveat: Long-term resource maps do not supply chronological dispatch profiles.

datasets.name: Global Solar Atlas
datasets.use: Screen solar resource and photovoltaic potential with downloadable maps.
datasets.caveat: Long-term averages do not replace hourly weather or site measurements.

datasets.name: Annual Technology Baseline (ATB)
datasets.use: Start technology cost, performance and financing assumptions with explicit scenarios.
datasets.caveat: Freeze the release, cost year and scenario; these are assumptions, not project quotes.

datasets.name: Danish Energy Agency: energy storage
datasets.use: Compare storage efficiency, lifetime and cost assumptions.
datasets.caveat: Technology and regional assumptions need adaptation; read uncertainty ranges.

datasets.name: Danish Energy Agency: renewable fuels
datasets.use: Parameterize hydrogen, electrolysis and fuel-conversion pathways.
datasets.caveat: Keep process boundaries and input/output energy conventions consistent.

datasets.name: PNNL storage cost and performance
datasets.use: Compare storage technologies by duration, efficiency, lifetime and cost.
datasets.caveat: Check duration and system boundaries; cost estimates are not vendor bids.

datasets.name: DOE H2A production models
datasets.use: Examine transparent hydrogen-production technoeconomic assumptions.
datasets.caveat: Spreadsheet models require scenario choices; headline hydrogen cost is a model result.

datasets.name: Battery Archive
datasets.use: Explore cell cycling, degradation and test-condition data.
datasets.caveat: Cell experiments do not directly describe grid-scale projects; complete CSVs may require a request.

datasets.name: EIA natural gas prices
datasets.use: Set historical natural-gas price inputs and compare market trends.
datasets.caveat: Spot benchmarks differ from plant-delivered gas and firm transport costs.

datasets.name: EIA coal data
datasets.use: Find coal prices, production and consumption for fuel assumptions.
datasets.caveat: Match coal quality, geography and delivered-versus-mine price definitions.

datasets.name: World Bank Pink Sheet
datasets.use: Compare long-run energy and commodity benchmark prices.
datasets.caveat: Monthly global benchmarks are not locational forward curves or plant fuel contracts.

datasets.name: IMF primary commodity prices
datasets.use: Cross-check commodity price series and aggregate indices.
datasets.caveat: Read series definitions and units; index values and absolute prices are different inputs.

datasets.name: ENTSOG Transparency Platform
datasets.use: Assess gas-system capacity and physical flows for fuel-security studies.
datasets.caveat: Physical gas flows do not provide a traded gas forward price curve.

datasets.name: ICE Dutch TTF futures
datasets.use: Identify the relevant traded gas contract for forward-price procurement.
datasets.caveat: Contract information is public; usable historical and forward market data require appropriate rights.

datasets.name: DSIRE
datasets.use: Find state and federal renewable-energy and efficiency policies and incentives.
datasets.caveat: Read the underlying law and current program rules before encoding a constraint.

datasets.name: IEA Policies database
datasets.use: Find energy policy measures by country, sector and technology.
datasets.caveat: Descriptions summarize policies; verify dates, legal force and data reuse terms.

datasets.name: World Bank RISE
datasets.use: Compare national regulatory frameworks for sustainable energy.
datasets.caveat: Scored indicators are policy assessments, not executable model constraints.

datasets.name: World Bank Carbon Pricing Dashboard
datasets.use: Locate carbon taxes, emissions-trading systems and coverage information.
datasets.caveat: Instrument coverage and nominal rates differ from a project's effective carbon cost.

datasets.name: FERC orders
datasets.use: Trace federal electricity-rule requirements to primary orders.
datasets.caveat: A document collection needs interpretation before it becomes a model input.

datasets.name: EEA EU ETS data
datasets.use: Find reported emissions, allowances and compliance information for EU ETS analysis.
datasets.caveat: Locate the specific EU ETS release in the portal; this is not a live allowance price feed.

datasets.name: PyPSA technology-data
datasets.use: Use compiled cost, efficiency and lifetime tables with source references.
datasets.caveat: Check currency, cost year, scenario and upstream source assumptions.

datasets.name: Lazard LCOE+
datasets.use: Sanity-check technology cost ranges and published financing assumptions.
datasets.caveat: LCOE is not total system cost; headline ranges do not replace model input tables.

datasets.name: IRENA renewable generation costs
datasets.use: Benchmark observed renewable project costs and country trends.
datasets.caveat: Project-year averages differ from future marginal build costs; follow the report's boundaries.

datasets.name: EIA Annual Energy Outlook assumptions
datasets.use: Use documented US technology, fuel and economic scenario assumptions.
datasets.caveat: Record the edition and scenario; projected outcomes are not observations.

datasets.name: OpenStreetMap infrastructure and land use
datasets.use: Extract power infrastructure, roads and land-use context for siting.
datasets.caveat: Volunteer coverage varies; ODbL obligations apply and map presence does not establish electrical capacity.

datasets.name: ESA WorldCover
datasets.use: Apply global 10 m land-cover classes to siting screens.
datasets.caveat: Map classification and vintage matter; land cover does not establish parcel availability.

datasets.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
datasets.use: Calculate terrain and slope constraints for screening.
datasets.caveat: A surface-elevation model is not a parcel survey; inspect product terms and void handling.

datasets.name: USGS PAD-US
datasets.use: Screen protected lands and public land management categories.
datasets.caveat: Protection and access categories require interpretation; absence is not development permission.

datasets.name: Protected Planet / WDPA
datasets.use: Screen globally designated protected areas.
datasets.caveat: Commercial use is restricted under publisher terms; designation does not capture every siting constraint.

datasets.name: USGS National Land Cover Database
datasets.use: Use US land cover and imperviousness for siting and demand geography.
datasets.caveat: Choose a consistent product vintage and resolution; classification has uncertainty.
